title: MQDEsys measured throughput submission
description: One file per `mqde bench` run (local/<hw-slug>/) or per imported record (community/<hw-slug>/). Field names follow llmfit's community format (docs/REFERENCES.md A.8). Matching is identical hardware only: hardware.hardwareName and hardware.cpu must equal this machine's, case-insensitive.

source.description: Required for community/ files: origin and license, e.g. 'llmfit community data (MIT)'.

hardwareName.description: GPU name as reported by the driver; empty/absent for CPU-only.

model.description: HF id or local path; matched by canonical slug (last segment, lower-case, '-', '_', '.' removed).

quant.description: Recipe id (bf16, w4a16, ...). Absent = matches any quant.

avgTtftMs.description: LLM: time to first token. steps/s models: mean decision-step latency.
